Command `set -e

rm -rf /tmp/uws-bug39335 && git worktree add -f /tmp/uws-bug39335 dd67cb0 >/dev/null
cd /tmp/uws-bug39335
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/TopicTree.h')
s=p.read_text()
old='''\n        /* We also need to unlink us */\n        if (s->needsDrainage()) {\n            if (s->prev) {\n                s->prev->next = s->next;\n            }\n            if (s->next) {\n                s->next->prev = s->prev;\n            }\n            /* If we are the head, then we also need to reset the head */\n            if (drainableSubscribers == s) {\n                drainableSubscribers = nullptr;\n            }\n        }\n'''
assert old in s
p.write_text(s.replace(old,'\n'))
PY
mkdir -p /tmp/uwsbugbuild
gcc -c /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libfuzzer/standalone/StandaloneFuzzTargetMain.c -o /tmp/uwsbugbuild/main.o
g++ -std=c++17 -g -O1 -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer fuzzing/TopicTree.cpp /tmp/uwsbugbuild/main.o -o /tmp/uwsbugbuild/TopicTree_bug
/tmp/uwsbugbuild/TopicTree_bug /workspace/poc_topic_uaf > /tmp/bugpoc.out 2>&1; echo exit:$?; tail -80 /tmp/bugpoc.out` executed with exit code -1.
